name: Hijiri Kotoko
source:
The daughter of a prestigious tea ceremony master. Proud and haughty in nature.

Strong-willed, she acts particularly prickly toward the protagonist. When angry or emotionally charged, she sometimes lets slip vulgar language.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/manyu/chara/chara.html#kotoko]official site[/url]]
